investment_theses.thesis: Long BTC/short DXY (dollar index): Democratic sweep + debt-ceiling brinkmanship forces Fed pause; crypto benefits from perceived fiscal recklessness and falling USD.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: 'Bitcoin hits $80.5K as US stocks rally on midterm election results'
CNBC: 'The next debt-ceiling confrontation could reverse Washington's traditional political roles, raising the possibility of spending concessions, market volatility'
CoinDesk: 'The election changes Washington. The work on crypto continues' + Clarity Act likely dead under Democratic Congress
investment_theses.counter_view: If debt-ceiling stalemate triggers real default risk or liquidity crunch, BTC could crash harder than DXY due to risk-off flight to safety; Democrats may surprise with fiscal restraint.
investment_theses.expression: BTC perpetuals (long) + short DXY (or short USDJPY if rates fall) via CME E-mini Yen futures; ratio trade BTC/DXY synthetic.
